lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in roughly four horizontal rows. The spots are most prominent in the mid-body region, showing a regular spacing that forms a grid-like pattern when viewed relative to the vertical axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Pale vertical bands of slightly higher pixel intensity than the dark base skin are visible, intersecting with the horizontal rows of spots to create a characteristic cross-hatched appearance.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge is visible running from the posterior gill region toward the caudal peduncle, showing a clear shadow-light contrast indicating a raised structural feature.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains numerous small, high-luminance blobs. These spots are distributed across the entire visible surface of the fin, with a higher concentration towards the base.

other_distinctive_markers: A highly reflective, elongated white object is visible attached or in close proximity to the ventral surface, posterior to the pectoral fin.
